name: 그림자도 빛이 있어야 존재 (Behind The Light)

lines.lyric: Cheoeum modu manna insa hannal gieok na
lines.lyric_hangul: 처음 모두 만나 인사한 날 기억나
lines.lyric_translation: I remember the day we all first met and said hello

lines.lyric: Georeummareul tteneun yeonseube urin agi eommacheoreom
lines.lyric_hangul: 걸음마를 떼는 연습에 우린 아기 엄마처럼
lines.lyric_translation: Our practice sessions were like babies on walkers
Like mothers making baby food

lines.lyric: Hanahana da shingyeong sseo chaenggyeosseotteon nal
lines.lyric_hangul: 하나하나 다 신경 써 챙겼었던 날
lines.lyric_translation: We paid attention to all the details
Compared to that passion
People’s reactions are impossible
If we were to react to that zero reaction
Our scars would have severely reacted
This song probably wouldn’t exist either
We were just thirsty for a bit
Feels as though we forgot those butterflies back then

lines.lyric: Dalli malhamyeon jeone bihae kkwaena uijeothaejin deuthae
lines.lyric_hangul: 달리 말하면 전에 비해 꽤나 의젓해진 듯해
lines.lyric_translation: In other words, seems like we’ve become quite reliable
Compared to before
Feels like we’ve been chased by time and have lost
It’s too much to be stubborn like ticks
Even with the insecticide / That is the end

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 꿈은 주체 못 해 내 앞이 까매도
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t press down on my dreams / Even if my future is bleak

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 열정이 손전등이 되어 앞을 밝혀
lines.lyric_translation: My passion becomes my lamp and casts a light before me / When nine come together

parts.lyric: Nae yeoljeongi sonjeondeungi dweeo apeul balkhyeo

lines.lyric_translation: It becomes a lighthouse and the situation changes
Don’t close your eyes again
There’s a shadow where the light shines
When you turn around

lines.lyric: Balgeun bichi neoreul gidaril geoya yeah
lines.lyric_translation: A bright light will be waiting for you

lines.lyric: Am I doing right or not
lines.lyric_hangul: Am I doing right or not
lines.lyric_translation: Am I doing right or not
Honestly, I was nervous back then

lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 우리를 비춰주는 많은 꽃들이 있기에
lines.lyric_translation: But now, there are so many flowers shining on us / (There are flowers)

parts.lyric: Jigeum urireul bichweojuneun maneun kkotteuri itgie

lines.lyric_translation: So I’m not unsure anymore

lines.lyric: One for the fame, one for the game
lines.lyric_hangul: One for the fame One for the game
lines.lyric_translation: One for the fame, one for the game
I don’t care when, just like them

lines.lyric: One for the way, I’m gonna take
lines.lyric_hangul: One for the way I'm gonna take
lines.lyric_translation: One for the way, I’m gonna take
Wherever you are, sing this song
Even if it gets farther away
I can’t stop
Even dark shadows
Only exist with light

lines.lyric: Urin hanagachi gateun bitman bogo dallyeoon geoya
lines.lyric_hangul: 우린 하나같이 같은 빛만 보고 달려온 거야
lines.lyric_translation: We’ve all only looked at the light and came this far
The brotherly love of us brothers
Connected by music and dance
I don’t regret it, even though I’m a bit tired

lines.lyric: Chikin meogeumyeonseo unneun ge jeulgeoul ppuniya
lines.lyric_hangul: 치킨 먹으면서 웃는 게 즐거울 뿐이야
lines.lyric_translation: I just like to eat chicken and laugh and have fun
The black and white prepares the world
Following it like crosswalk

lines.lyric: Geureol subakke eomneun ilsangeul saraga nan tto
lines.lyric_hangul: 그럴 수밖에 없는 일상을 살아가 난 또
lines.lyric_translation: I’m living a life that has no choice but to do so

lines.lyric: Mam pyeonhi geunyang utja mam pyeonhi
lines.lyric_translation: Let’s just comfortably laugh
Just think simply
Just work hard

lines.lyric: Ey, we never give up, yeah, yeah
lines.lyric_translation: Eh, we never give up, yeah (yeah)

lines.lyric: We never give up, yeah eh
lines.lyric_translation: We never give up, yeah eh

lines.lyric: We never give up, yeah eh
lines.lyric_hangul: We never give up 절대 포기 않아
lines.lyric_translation: We never give up, yeah eh
A light shines on us so we can overcome it all

lines.lyric: Da igyeonael su isseo geurimjaga uril samkyeodo
lines.lyric_translation: Even if shadows swallow us
Won’t ever give up / Oh, I believe my family / We won’t give up

lines.lyric: Nan wake up nae gippeun dreams fade away
lines.lyric_hangul: 난 Wake up 내 기쁜 Dreams fade away
lines.lyric_translation: I wake up, my happy dreams fade away

lines.lyric: Sum mot shwigesseo nae meori dabdabhaejine
lines.lyric_hangul: 숨 못 쉬겠어 내 머리 답답해지네
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t breathe, it’s so complicated
Same actions keep replaying
I can’t feel it even after time
In my head, colorless voices

lines.lyric: Stepping in nae maeumsoge hopeless choices
lines.lyric_hangul: Stepping in 내 마음속에 Hopeless choices
lines.lyric_translation: Stepping in my heart, hopeless choices

lines.lyric: I know I can’t succeed if I feed like this
lines.lyric_hangul: I know I can't succeed If I feed like this
lines.lyric_translation: I know I can’t succeed if I feed like this
Leave like this

lines.lyric: Scarred and feared pain like this, yeah
lines.lyric_translation: Scarred and feared pain like this, yeah

lines.lyric: One for the fame, one for the game
lines.lyric_hangul: One for the fame One for the game
lines.lyric_translation: One for the fame, one for the game
I don’t care when, just like them

lines.lyric: One for the way, I’m gonna take
lines.lyric_hangul: One for the way I'm gonna take
lines.lyric_translation: One for the way, I’m gonna take
Wherever you are, sing this song
Even if it gets farther away
I can’t stop
Even dark shadows
Only exist with light
I go through that too
But when things are hard, I look at the sky
It can’t always be light
But only when darkness comes
Can it get brighter
